# Love Palmers Green

> Community business association for Palmers Green, North London N13. Formerly Green Lanes Business Association (GLBA), established 1992.

Love Palmers Green supports local businesses, promotes the shopping area, and runs community events on Palmers Green High Street (Green Lanes) and The Triangle.

## Contact

- General: contact@lovepalmersgreen.com
- Membership and Christmas advertising: Costas, 07943 198 198, costas@lovepalmersgreen.com
- Website: https://lovepalmersgreen.com
- Area: Palmers Green, London N13, London Borough of Enfield, North London
- Coordinates: 51.6175, -0.1025

## Upcoming events 2026

- Halloween Trick or Treat on the High Street: Saturday 31 October 2026, 10:00–20:00. Pumpkin Hunt 10:00–16:30 across 24 shops. Mini-Monster Disco at The Fox, 413 Green Lanes, N13 4JD, 16:00–20:00. Sponsored by Peter Michael Estates and Lettings. Organised by Love Palmers Green / GLBA. Pickup hunt forms from participating High Street shops and Peter Michael.
- Christmas Lights Switch-On: Thursday 26 November 2026, 15:30 at The Triangle, Palmers Green. Live performances by St Monica's Choir and Adorned Gospel Community Choir.
- Christmas Stocking Hunt: Saturday 5 December 2026, Palmers Green High Street.
